podcast.title: Connection to "Grease" (1978)
podcast.body: Frankie Valli sang the theme song for the movie "Grease" because his vocal style evoked the sounds of the 1950s and pre-Beatles 1960s, aligning with the film's nostalgic theme. "when Greece is made into a movie Frankie Valley has a hand in that because he sang the theme song why because he sounds like the 50s and pre Beatles 60s."

podcast.title: Focus on Pure Entertainment
podcast.body: Frankie Valli described the band's shows as "pure entertainment" and stated, "we are a people's act," emphasizing their role in providing a space free from political or social commentary, which resonated with those seeking nostalgia and escape. "Frankie Valley set of the shows put on by the four seasons they don't claim to be an expert on politics or social change it is pure entertainment to sum it up we are a people's act."

srcs.episode: Ep. 31 - The Spirit of '76 - Pop Music on America's Bicentennial

podcast.title: Return to Prominence with Disco
podcast.body: Frankie Valli and The Four Seasons, who had been making hit records before The Beatles, had not had major hits since the late 1960s but returned to the top 10 by making disco records in 1975. "Frankie Valley in the four seasons would make disco records in 1975."
